svg.text: Detailed architecture map · every project, its responsibility and its place in the engineering chain
56 entries = 2 programme anchors + 13 neuromorphic destinations + 25 supporting tools + 16 circuit destinations
Integrated simulation, learning, analysis, acceleration and compilation; hardware-oriented workflows and experimental visual Studio.
The parent remains the integration workbench; separate component extraction has its own acceptance gates.
Loop and accelerator latency, jitter, deadlines, fault response and energy measurements. Physical
All destinations have documented architectural ownership and planning material. Reviewed plans do not make their implementations complete.
Status labels below describe delivery. Lines show intended integration and responsibility; they do not prescribe package imports or extraction order.

SC-NEUROCORE remains the public workbench. Thirteen
destinations give focused ownership and future release
COMPILER and HARDWARE may consume optional general
circuit adapters. Simulation and learning do not acquire
supplies the shared execution and result protocol.
Design or model identity → versioned inputs →
Shared hashing, sealing and lineage preserve provenance.
Domain laws, numerical oracles and physical calibration
Neither a scaffold nor a valid record establishes a qualified
measurement or an independently reproduced result.
Neuromorphic workloads use the general circuit platform
through optional contracts. General circuit engineering
does not require an SNN runtime.
CORE and TECHNOLOGY define shared identities and
operation contracts; FLOW dispatches admitted providers.
analogue, digital and specialist physics retain distinct
Measured feedback creates a new design revision; original
Design + technology → simulation / implementation → physical checks → assembly → manufacturing handoff → laboratory evidence
CIRCUIT-MANUFACTURING owns routes, recipes and materials; CIRCUIT-AUTOMATION connects admitted local equipment providers.
Local controllers retain timing, equipment arbitration, interlocks and protection. No fabrication capability or machine-control authority is implied.
Analogue · digital · mixed-signal · RF / fields · photonics · device physics / MEMS · die / package / board
CMOS / SOI · SiGe / BiCMOS · GaAs / InP · GaN / SiC · optical and specialist functional materials — support is qualified per operation.
